headline: GOLD CRACKS $3,977 INTRADAY — Worst Weekly Decline Since June as Oil Fires Up December Hike Bets
snippet: Spot gold hit an intraday low of $3,977.95 on October 26, the metal's worst weekly performance in four months, as surging oil prices revived inflation expectations and pushed markets to price a 79% probability of a December Fed rate hike. The decisive breach of $4,000 — a level the previous session had briefly defended — arrives two days before the FOMC decision under Chair Kevin Warsh, with technical support now at $3,970–$3,985.

headline: LI-FT POWER HITS 56M AT 1.43% Li2O IN FIRST ADINA-GALINÉE ASSAYS — Quebec Pegmatite System Intact Across Five Holes
snippet: Li-FT Power (TSXV: LIFT, ASX: LFT) released first assays from 5 of 45 holes in its 2026 Adina-Galinée program in Quebec: hole ALP0002 returned 56 metres at 1.43% Li2O from 187m to 243m depth in the Galinée Zone. The results confirm a large, continuous spodumene-bearing pegmatite system — the key geometry needed to support a bulk-tonnage resource estimate — across the first five holes of a 45-hole campaign.

headline: AVINO DRILLS 8.45M AT 616 G/T SILVER-EQUIV AT LA PRECIOSA — 13-Hole Phase 1 Defines High-Grade La Gloria Structure, Durango
snippet: Avino Silver & Gold Mines (TSX: ASM) reported first-phase 2026 drill results from La Preciosa in Durango, Mexico: 13 holes highlighted by 8.45 metres at 616 g/t silver-equivalent from the high-grade La Gloria structure. The results confirm and extend the mineralized footprint at La Preciosa ahead of a planned resource update.

headline: NEW BREAK RESOURCES LAUNCHES FALL PROGRAM AT MORAY GOLD — 5,372M IN 32 HOLES DONE; TIMMINS-AREA ONTARIO PROJECT ADVANCES
source_name: Junior Mining Network / New Break Resources
snippet: New Break Resources (CSE: NBRK) refined drill targets and resumed its 2026 program at the Moray Gold Project, 49km south of Timmins, Ontario. The earlier 2026 campaign delivered 5,372 metres in 32 holes including best results of 5.28 g/t Au over 11.2m and 3.95 g/t Au over 14.0m; the fall program targets higher-priority zones along the Zavitz gold zone, which traces 200 metres of strike to 100m vertical depth and is compared structurally to Alamos Gold's nearby Young-Davidson mine.

headline: CHINA RARE EARTH TRUCE EXPIRES NOVEMBER 10 — Beijing Silent on Extension as 0.1% Extraterritorial Rule Threatens Global Supply Chain
snippet: China's one-year suspension of its expanded rare earth export controls expires November 10, 2026, potentially reinstating the 0.1% extraterritorial rule that reaches foreign-made products containing Chinese-origin rare earths. While U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent publicly claimed a January 2027 extension at a September 24 briefing, Beijing has published no confirming legal text — leaving Western rare earth miners, defence contractors, and magnet makers with 15 days of compounding policy uncertainty ahead of the January 1, 2027 U.S. DFARS procurement ban on Chinese-sourced magnets.

headline: GDX DOWN 16.5% IN A MONTH WHILE GOLD HOLDS $3,985 — Record AISC Costs, Grade Sequencing and By-Product Drought Expose the Equity-Metal Disconnect
snippet: October 26 analysis examines why gold miners ETFs have fallen 16.5% in one month even as spot gold holds near $4,000: global average all-in sustaining costs hit a record $1,785/oz in Q1 2026 — up 16% year-on-year — driven by royalties rising 85% and grade sequencing headwinds pushing producers into lower-quality ore sequences. The piece identifies by-product credit accounting as the key variable separating expanding-margin operators from those whose reported costs are approaching gold's current spot price.

headline: BOND YIELDS HIT OCTOBER HIGHS AS GOLD TRADES BELOW $4,000 — All Eyes on Warsh Press Conference Wednesday for December Rate Signal
snippet: U.S. Treasury yields climbed to fresh October highs on October 26, squeezing gold from two directions — oil-driven inflation expectations and rising real yields. Benzinga's analysis argues that with the Fed widely expected to hold rates this week (90% probability priced in), Fed Chair Warsh's press conference tone on the December rate path has become the single decisive near-term catalyst for gold and mining equities now trading at unusually wide discounts to spot.

headline: MINING EXPERT: 'NOTHING CHANGES THE THEMATIC' — Lithium and Copper Long-Term Thesis Intact Despite 25% Monthly Crash in Spot Prices
snippet: With lithium carbonate and spodumene prices down 25% in one month and LME copper retreating 4% from its September all-time high of $14,875, one senior mining industry figure argues the structural demand thesis for battery metals and critical minerals remains intact. The short-term price pressure is attributed to institutional de-risking ahead of monetary policy decisions, not a fundamental reset of the electric vehicle and grid storage growth trajectory.
